  • Method Details

    • complete

      public PaymentExecutionResult complete(CompletePaymentSubmissionCommand command)
      Locks and verifies the persisted payment, completes the matching idempotency record, schedules affected dashboards, and validates that the response matches persisted identity and state. It does not authorize, move funds, transition execution, or dispatch a provider.
      Parameters:
      command - completion inputs tied to the owning submission
      Returns:
      verified payment execution response
